track: 02 · The Agent That Can Explain Why

build.role: Memory with provenance: approved answers are stored with their sources, recalled for the next question about the same code, set aside when those lines change, and ranked by a trust ledger fed by Helpful / Not helpful / Wrong
build.evidence: npm run hmem:conformance passes the vendored Meterless conformance suite; test/hmem.test.ts; the Remembered panel under every answer in the desk

power.role: Primary AI provider: every agent call goes to Meterless Runtime (Nightshift) over its OpenAI-compatible API, with NVIDIA direct as a fallback only when the runtime is unreachable
power.evidence: test/meterless.test.ts, test/client.test.ts; npm run sponsors and the desk's Powered by panel show the runtime's live state

nvidia.role: Nemotron models behind every agent: nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b reads files and writes answers; the Scout, Cartographer and Reviewer ask nemotron-3.5-super-120b and nemotron-3-ultra-550b at once and keep the first valid answer; Ultra is the Critic
nvidia.evidence: npm run smoke checks cited evidence verbatim against the code; npm run usage shows calls and tokens per model

zetaris.role: Data layer: the evidence store (git history, blame, pull requests, issues, review discussion) is a JDBC datasource in Zetaris, modelled as the 'provenance' Unified Semantic Layer with keys, relationships and data-quality rules that flag changes with no review trail and pull requests that never state a reason
zetaris.evidence: npm run zetaris:setup compiles, activates and runs DQ on the USL; Find out why and Why-coverage in the desk query it live

preExisting.component: Cartograph map pipeline, MCP server and map UI
preExisting.note: Imported as the starting point; hackathon work extends it

runWithoutKeys: npm install && npm test (every integration is tested against mocks)
